frameworks: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Supply Chain Risk Management and related controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 GV.SC (Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management).

rules.title: Vendor assessment is overdue or has never been done
rules.remediation: Send the security questionnaire, review the vendor's certifications, and record the assessment date; Tier 1 vendors should be reassessed at least yearly.

rules.title: Contract has no security requirements
rules.remediation: Add a security addendum requiring the vendor to maintain safeguards appropriate to the data and access it receives.

rules.title: Contract has no breach notification clause
rules.remediation: Require the vendor to notify you of security incidents affecting your data or systems within a set time, such as 72 hours.

rules.title: Contract has no right to audit or assess
rules.remediation: Add the right to request evidence (such as a SOC 2 report) or to assess the vendor's controls.

rules.title: No data return or destruction terms at contract end
rules.remediation: Require return or certified destruction of your data when the relationship ends, and revoke the vendor's access.

rules.title: Vendor has remote access without MFA
rules.remediation: Require MFA for all vendor remote access, route it through your VPN or a remote access tool you control, and enable it only when needed.

rules.title: Vendor reported a breach in the last 24 months
rules.remediation: Ask for the incident report and corrective actions, confirm whether your data was affected, and reassess the vendor.

rules.title: Weak vendor controls protecting sensitive data
rules.remediation: Agree on a remediation plan with dates, limit the data shared, or consider an alternative vendor.

rules.title: Security questionnaire is incomplete
rules.remediation: Follow up on unanswered questions; unanswered items are scored as not in place until confirmed.
